response: ["The case has been routed to MEL (melanoma) for management guidance.", "The licensed guideline corpus provides recommendations for initial local management of melanoma.", "According to PMID 30392755, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.", "The same guideline recommends surgical excision for melanoma in situ.", "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.", "According to PMID 39709737, when melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow margin of 1–3 mm to perform histological diagnosis.", "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.", "The recommendation has a consensus rate of 100% (21/21)."]
